name: hare-dayori
description: 明るいニュースを短い紹介と出典リンクで届ける静的サイト

scripts.test:lambda: aws lambda invoke --function-name google_news_scraper --payload '{}' response.json && cat response.json
scripts.deploy:legacy: npm run create:package && npm run deploy:package && npm run wait:update && npm run deploy:config && npm run wait:update
scripts.dev: npm run build:demo && python3 -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist-demo
scripts.preview: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dist
scripts.deploy:preview: npm test && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name hare-dayori --branch main
